jp: ヤマト「さて、戻ってきたけど‥‥」
en: Yamato: Well, we're back, but...

jp: トウヤ「ん？　誰だ？　開いてるぜ」
en: Touya: Hm? Who's there? It's open.

jp: デロック「んふ～さっきは助かったんだな。{nl}　お礼をしに来たんだな」
en: Derock: Nfufu~ You were a big help earlier, y'see. I came to thank you, is how it is.

jp: トウヤ「え？　お礼？」
en: Touya: Huh? Thank me?

jp: デロック「そうなんだな。キミにはこの特製シールを{nl}　あげるんだな」
en: Derock: That's right, y'see. I'm giving you this special sticker, is how it is.

jp: ヤマト「うわっ、デロックが満面の笑みを浮かべてる‥‥」
en: Yamato: Whoa, Derock's beaming from ear to ear...

jp: デロック「限定100枚の激レアものなんだな。{nl}　キミだけは特別なんだな」
en: Derock: It's super rare, limited to 100, y'see. I'm making an exception just for you, is how it is.

jp: トウヤ「‥‥え、遠慮しとく。使いみちないし」
en: Touya: ...I-I'll pass. I wouldn't have any use for it.

jp: デロック「う～ん、なにが不満なのかわからないんだな。{nl}　でも、無理にあげても意味がないんだな。{nl}　それじゃ‥‥おお」
en: Derock: Hmmm, I don't get what you're unhappy about, y'see. But there's no point forcing it on you, is how it is. In that case... oh.

jp: ヤマト「嫌ニャ予感‥‥」
en: Yamato: I've got a bad feeling about this, nya...

jp: デロック「僕がこの世界の国について講釈して{nl}　あげるんだな」
en: Derock: I'll give you a lecture on the countries of this world, y'see.

jp: トウヤ「説明してくれるってことか？」
en: Touya: You mean you'll explain them to me?

jp: デロック「そういうことなんだな。{nl}　さぁ、どこの国のことを訊きたいんだな」
en: Derock: That's how it is, y'see. Now, which country do you want to ask about, hm?

jp: アガルティア王国について訊く{nl}　別の国について訊く{nl}　やっぱりいい
en: About the Kingdom of Agarthia{nl}About another country{nl}Never mind

jp: ジグリム共和国について訊く{nl}　別の国について訊く{nl}　さっきの‥‥
en: About the Zigrim Republic{nl}About another country{nl}That last one again...

jp: ヨークについて訊く{nl}　さっきの‥‥{nl}　もういい。
en: About York{nl}That last one again...{nl}That's enough.

jp: デロック「わかったんだな。また訊きたくなったら僕に{nl}　なんでも訊くんだな。{nl}　それじゃ、これで帰るんだな‥‥」
en: Derock: Got it, y'see. If you want to ask again, ask me anything, is how it is. Well, I'll be heading back now, y'see...

jp: ヤマト「ちょ、ちょっと、そっちは洗面所よ。{nl}　出口はこっち」
en: Yamato: W-wait, that's the washroom. The exit's over here.

jp: デロック「‥‥そんなことわかってるんだな。{nl}　こっちのほうが近道なんだな。でも、やっぱり普通に{nl}　帰るんだな。それじゃ、なんだな」
en: Derock: ...I knew that, y'see. This way's a shortcut, is how it is. But I'll go back the normal way after all. Well then, y'see.

jp: ヤマト「‥‥普通じゃニャい方法ってどんニャ{nl}　方法ニャのかニャ？」
en: Yamato: ...What kind of nyon-normal way out is that, nya?

jp: トウヤ「さ、さぁ‥‥」
en: Touya: B-beats me...

jp: デロック「いいか、良く聞くんだな。{nl}　世界の名前と同じ名を持つこの国はその名のとおり、{nl}　元々この世界を統一していたんだな。{nl}　首都はシャングリアと言うんだな。{nl}　歴史上幾度か分裂し、暗黒時代の断絶は{nl}　あったが、3000年の歴史を誇っているんだな。{nl}　今でもその国土は大陸のおよそほぼ半数を占め、{nl}　この世界の盟主的役割を担っているんだな。{nl}　穏健な立憲君主国で、過去の歴史から{nl}　周辺諸国からやや批判的な目でみられていることが{nl}　多いんだな。{nl}　18の自治体で構成され、その中の12の都市は{nl}　アガルティア評議会の解散、選出権をもち、{nl}　“12選定都市”と呼ばれているんだな。{nl}　また、国土の中に“聖地”とよばれる地域があり、{nl}　独立領的な扱いとなっているんだな。{nl}　ちなみに“聖地”とは練金学士の学び舎であり、{nl}　研究所であり、工房#915でもある総本山なんだな。{nl}　そもそもは練金学の悪用を戒め、{nl}　“健全な技術の発達のための協力”を{nl}　目的として設立されたんだな。{nl}　いかなる国家権力にも影響されることなく、{nl}　どの国も武力行使を禁じらた不可侵の聖域{nl}　なんだな。{nl}　以上で説明終わりなんだな」
en: Derock: Now, listen well, y'see. This country shares its name with the world, and just as that name says, it originally unified this entire world, y'see. Its capital is called Shangria. It split apart several times over its history, and there was the break of the Dark Ages, but it boasts 3,000 years of history, is how it is. Even now its territory covers roughly half the continent, and it plays the role of this world's leading power, y'see. It's a moderate constitutional monarchy, and because of its past it's often viewed somewhat critically by the neighboring countries, see. It's made up of 18 self-governing regions, and 12 of those cities hold the right to dissolve and elect the Agarthian Council, so they're called the "Twelve Elector Cities," y'see. Also, within its territory is a region called the "Holy Land," which is treated as an independent domain, is how it is. By the way, the "Holy Land" is the head seat of the alchemists: their school, their research institute and their workshop all in one, y'see. It was founded to guard against the misuse of alchemy, with the aim of "cooperation for the sound development of technology," see. It's an inviolable sanctuary, untouched by any national power, where every nation is forbidden to use force, is how it is. And that concludes the explanation, y'see.

jp: デロック「いいか、良く聞くんだな。{nl}　1800年前の戦乱でアガルティア王国から{nl}　独立した国なんだな。{nl}　アガルティア王国に次ぐ国力と国土をもってるんだな。{nl}　もともとは王政で、1050年前に革命によって{nl}　共和制に移行したんだな。{nl}　その際、アガルティア王国から様々な圧迫を受けて、{nl}　その後も幾度となくアガルティア王国と戦ってるんだな。{nl}　政治的感覚、諜報組織などはアガルティア王国より{nl}　すぐれているんだな。{nl}　また軍隊も近代化がすすんでおり、その精強さには{nl}　定評があり、侮蔑と脅威を同時に込めて、{nl}　“西の蛮勇”と呼ばれているんだな。{nl}　国家元首は大統領で、現在はネル・ホーレムと言う{nl}　人物が務めているんだな。大統領は国民投票に{nl}　よって選出されているが、軍部の力が強く、{nl}　実質的な権力はグロウスター大将が握っていると{nl}　いっても過言ではないんだな。{nl}　以上で説明終わりなんだな」
en: Derock: Now, listen well, y'see. It's a country that broke away from the Kingdom of Agarthia in a war 1,800 years ago. It has the most national power and territory after the Kingdom of Agarthia, y'see. It was originally a monarchy, and 1,050 years ago a revolution turned it into a republic, is how it is. At the time it suffered all sorts of pressure from the Kingdom of Agarthia, and it has fought the Kingdom of Agarthia countless times since, y'see. Its political instincts and intelligence networks are superior to the Kingdom of Agarthia's, see. Its army is highly modernized too, and so renowned for its strength that it's called the "Wild Valor of the West," a name full of scorn and fear at once, y'see. The head of state is the President, and the office is currently held by a man named Nell Horem, is how it is. The President is chosen by popular vote, but the military is powerful, and it's no exaggeration to say that real power lies with General Growster, y'see. And that concludes the explanation, y'see.

jp: デロック「んふ～なかなかいいところをつくんだな。{nl}　かつてそこに集落を築いていたある民族がその発祥と{nl}　され、古来の地域名がそのまま国の名称となって{nl}　るんだな。女系国家であり、当然国家元首は女王{nl}　なんだな。アガルティア王国とは異なり、絶対王政的な{nl}　統治体制をとっているんだな。{nl}　国土はあまり大きくないが、その肥沃な大地と{nl}　貴重な鉱物を産出する鉱脈は過去、いくどとなく{nl}　侵略の対象とされ、閉鎖的な社会を築きあげるに{nl}　至ってるんだな。ヨークには女王個人に忠誠を誓う{nl}　“三剣騎士”と呼ばれる者達もいるんだな。{nl}　彼らによってこの国が守られているといっても{nl}　過言ではないんだな。{nl}　高い技術力をもっており、聖地の装兵機技術とは{nl}　系譜のことなる技術で、独自の装兵機を{nl}　作り上げているんだな。{nl}　ヨークの装兵機の性能はどの国もみとめるものだが、{nl}　その絶対数は少なく、軍隊とよべるものはないんだな。{nl}　でも、大陸で三人しかいない“剣煌”の称号をもつ、{nl}　騎士、ガリュード・ビア・ヴラッツェンの存在はまさに{nl}　“守護神”であり、彼が王国を守るようになって{nl}　以来、表立って軍を動かす国は皆無となったんだな。{nl}　まさに小数精鋭なんだな。ジグリムに負けたのは{nl}　いくつかの不幸が重なったんだな。{nl}　アルフォリナ女王は立派な人だったんだな。{nl}　‥‥以上で説明終わりなんだな」
en: Derock: Nfu~ You've picked a good one, y'see. A people who once built settlements there are said to be its origin, and the old name of the region became the country's name as it was, is how it is. It's a matrilineal state, so naturally the head of state is a queen, y'see. Unlike the Kingdom of Agarthia, it's governed as an absolute monarchy, see. Its territory isn't very large, but its fertile land and its veins of precious minerals have made it a target of invasion countless times, which led it to build a closed society, y'see. York also has people called the "Three Sword Knights," who swear loyalty to the queen herself. It's no exaggeration to say they're what protects this country, is how it is. It has advanced technology, and builds its own Armored Mechs with techniques from a different lineage than the Holy Land's Armored Mech technology, y'see. Every country recognizes the performance of York's Armored Mechs, but there are few of them in absolute numbers, and nothing you could call an army, see. But the knight Garyud Via Vratzen, who holds the title of "Sword Radiance" that only three people on the continent bear, is a true "guardian deity," and since he began protecting the kingdom, not a single country has openly moved troops against it, y'see. A small but elite force, truly, is how it is. Its defeat by Zigrim came from several misfortunes piling up, y'see. Queen Alforina was a fine person, y'see. ...And that concludes the explanation, y'see.
